name: Mini Football Manager
concept_focus: Lists of dictionaries and interacting state, then a full season: fixtures, a table, injuries, rival clubs and a manager's assistant

story.title: The Cursed Cup
story.hook: Ashford Rovers have finished last for eleven seasons, and the league says they are cursed. Odette thinks they are just badly run. Build her a manager's desk, from the squad sheet to the whole season, and take the Rovers up against the Invincibles.

acts.title: Act I: The Squad
acts.goal: Squad data, searching, a budget and transfers that move everything at once.

acts.title: Act II: Match Day
acts.goal: A valid line-up, team strength, a believable match engine and a run of results.

acts.title: Act III: The Season
acts.goal: A fixture list, a league table, fitness and injuries, and rival clubs that trade.

acts.title: Act IV: The Dynasty
acts.goal: An assistant who picks the best side, an academy that grows players, and seasons saved one after another.

boss_lore: The Invincibles have not lost in three seasons. They are not magic; they are simply managed better than anyone else.
boss_brief: Bring a finished football_manager.py: squad and market data, budget-checked transfers, valid line-ups, a match engine from team strength, a round-robin season with a sorted league table, fatigue and injuries, rival clubs trading, an assistant that picks the best eleven, an academy, and seasons saved and continued.

mobs.name: The Scout
mobs.encounter: Build squad data with name, position, rating and value and show it in a readable way.
mobs.contract: Odette hands you a crumpled team sheet. Turn it into data you can trust and a squad list anyone can read.

objectives.label: Build the squad
objectives.brief: In football_manager.py, build a squad of at least 16 players as dictionaries with name, position, rating, age and value.

objectives.label: Show the squad
objectives.brief: Print the squad as aligned columns grouped by position.

objectives.label: Explain the shape
objectives.brief: Explain why each player is a dictionary in a list rather than separate lists of names and ratings.

mobs.name: The Talent Spotter
mobs.encounter: Find players in the squad or market by position or rating and explain how the search decides who matches.
mobs.contract: The Spotter only ever asks two things: what position, how good? Answer them for the squad and the market alike.

objectives.label: Build the market
objectives.brief: Build a transfer market as a second list with the same player shape.

objectives.label: Search players
objectives.brief: Write a search that filters either list by position and minimum rating, and sorts the results best first.

objectives.label: Predict a search
objectives.brief: Predict who a search for defenders rated 70 or more returns, then check it.

mobs.name: The Accountant
mobs.encounter: Track a club budget and decide whether a transfer is affordable before anything changes.
mobs.contract: The Accountant has seen clubs go bankrupt over one signing. Every penny is checked before it moves.

objectives.label: Keep the budget
objectives.brief: Give the club a budget and a wage bill and show both on the main screen.

objectives.label: Check affordability
objectives.brief: Write a check that says whether a transfer fits the budget, with the reason when it does not.

objectives.label: Check before changing
objectives.brief: Explain what goes wrong if you take the money first and check afterwards, and show your order.

mobs.name: The Negotiator
mobs.encounter: Buy a player so budget, squad and market all change together, and explain what breaks if only one of them does.
mobs.contract: A signing touches three ledgers: the budget, your squad and the market. The Negotiator never lets one change without the others.

objectives.label: Sign a player
objectives.brief: Write buy_player that moves a player from the market to the squad and takes the fee, all or nothing.

objectives.label: Sell a player
objectives.brief: Write sell_player that does the reverse, refusing to sell below a minimum squad size.

objectives.label: Explain the half-update
objectives.brief: Explain what breaks if a signing adds the player but forgets to remove him from the market.

mobs.name: The Gaffer
mobs.encounter: Pick a simplified starting lineup from the squad and reject selections that are impossible or incomplete.
mobs.contract: The Gaffer names eleven on Saturday, and the league checks every one. Pick a side the rules will accept.

objectives.label: Pick eleven
objectives.brief: Let the manager pick eleven players by number from the squad.

objectives.label: Validate the side
objectives.brief: Reject a line-up with duplicates, the wrong count, no goalkeeper, or a formation that does not fit (for example 4-4-2).

objectives.label: Catch the duplicate
objectives.brief: Explain how picking the same player twice could slip through, and how your check stops it.

mobs.name: The Tactician
mobs.encounter: Reduce a lineup to a single team-strength number and justify why your formula is fair.
mobs.contract: Eleven ratings, one number. The Tactician wants a strength that rewards a balanced side, not just stars.

objectives.label: Compute strength
objectives.brief: Compute team strength from the line-up, weighting each player by how well their position fits the slot they play.

objectives.label: Pin the formula
objectives.brief: Add assert checks that pin your formula on two small example line-ups, one balanced and one with players out of position.

objectives.label: Defend the formula
objectives.brief: Explain why your formula is fairer than a plain average of ratings.

mobs.name: The Match Engine
mobs.encounter: Produce believable results from team strength plus randomness, where the stronger side usually but not always wins.
mobs.contract: Odette's board wants results that feel real. The better side usually wins. Usually.

objectives.label: Play a match
objectives.brief: Simulate a match as goal chances over 90 minutes, where each side's chance to score depends on its strength.

objectives.label: Measure upsets
objectives.brief: Simulate 1,000 matches between a strong and a weak side and report win, draw and loss rates.

objectives.label: Judge realism
objectives.brief: Explain whether your upset rate feels like real football and what you tuned.

mobs.name: The Fixture Keeper
mobs.encounter: Run several matches in a row and keep a running record of wins, draws and losses.
mobs.contract: A season is a story told one result at a time. The Keeper writes every one down.

objectives.label: Record the results
objectives.brief: Play a run of matches and record each opponent, score and result in a list of dictionaries.

objectives.label: Show the form
objectives.brief: Show the club's record and its last five results as form, for example WDLWW.

objectives.label: Repeat a run
objectives.brief: Run the same three matches twice with the same random seed, show the results match, and explain why a seed makes a simulation repeatable.

mobs.name: The Fixture Weaver
mobs.encounter: Schedule a full league season where everyone plays everyone home and away.
mobs.contract: The league has eight clubs and one rule: everyone plays everyone, home and away. Weave the calendar so nobody plays twice in a week.

objectives.label: Build the league
objectives.brief: Create eight clubs with squads generated from a rating range, Ashford Rovers among them.

objectives.label: Weave the fixtures
objectives.brief: Generate a schedule of match weeks where every club plays every other club home and away, and nobody plays twice in a week.

objectives.label: Check the calendar
objectives.brief: Write checks that every pairing appears exactly twice and explain the mistake they caught or would catch.

mobs.name: The League Table
mobs.encounter: Keep a league table with points and goal difference, sorted properly.
mobs.contract: Three points for a win, one for a draw, and when points tie, goal difference decides. The table is the truth of the season.

objectives.label: Keep the table
objectives.brief: Keep each club's played, won, drawn, lost, goals for, goals against and points, updated after every match.

objectives.label: Sort the table
objectives.brief: Sort by points, then goal difference, then goals scored, using a key that returns a tuple.

objectives.label: Predict a tie-break
objectives.brief: Predict the order of three clubs level on points with different goal differences, then check it.

mobs.name: The Physio
mobs.encounter: Make players tire and get injured, and keep the unfit out of the side.
mobs.contract: Ashford's physio says the squad is held together with tape. Players tire, players get hurt, and a hurt player does not play.

objectives.label: Track fatigue
objectives.brief: Lower fitness for players who play, recover it for those who rest, and let low fitness reduce their rating in matches.

objectives.label: Add injuries
objectives.brief: Give tired players a higher chance of injury, with a number of weeks out that counts down.

objectives.label: Bench the injured
objectives.brief: Make the line-up check refuse injured players and explain where that check has to live.

mobs.name: The Rival Directors
mobs.concept: AI clubs acting in the market
mobs.encounter: Let rival clubs buy and sell in a transfer window.
mobs.contract: The other seven clubs are not standing still. In the window their directors buy, sell and sometimes steal your targets.

objectives.label: Open the window
objectives.brief: Hold a transfer window mid-season where rival clubs act in turn.

objectives.label: Give rivals a plan
objectives.brief: Let each rival buy the best affordable player for its weakest position, using the same buy function you use.

objectives.label: Report the news
objectives.brief: Print a transfer news feed of every move made in the window.

mobs.name: The Assistant Manager
mobs.encounter: Let an assistant pick the strongest valid eleven for a formation.
mobs.contract: Odette hires you an assistant. Give it a formation and a squad, and it names the strongest eleven the rules allow.

objectives.label: Pick the best eleven
objectives.brief: Write a function that fills each position in a formation with the best fit, fit and available player.

objectives.label: Pick the formation
objectives.brief: Try several formations and recommend the one with the highest team strength.

objectives.label: Explain the shortcut
objectives.brief: Explain why filling positions one at a time might not always find the very best side, and when it is good enough.

mobs.name: The Academy
mobs.encounter: Grow young players and age old ones across seasons.
mobs.contract: Ashford cannot buy stars, so it must grow them. Young players improve with minutes; old ones fade.

objectives.label: Develop players
objectives.brief: At the end of a season, raise young players' ratings by their minutes played and lower ratings for players past their peak.

objectives.label: Bring in youth
objectives.brief: Add a youth intake of new young players each season and retire the oldest.

objectives.label: Predict a development
objectives.brief: Predict a 19-year-old's rating after a season of regular football with your formula, then check.

mobs.name: The Season Archive
mobs.encounter: Save the whole club and league, and start the next season from it.
mobs.contract: A dynasty is built season on season. Archive everything at the final whistle and carry it into the next year.

objectives.label: Archive the season
objectives.brief: Save the clubs, squads, budget, table and results to a JSON file at the end of a season.

objectives.label: Start the next season
objectives.brief: Load the archive, run development and a youth intake, reset the table and generate new fixtures.

objectives.label: Hand out awards
objectives.brief: Announce the champion, top scorer and your club's finish, and keep a list of past champions.
